newsitem.title: PERU: 72-year-old arrested in Peruvian cocaine bust.
newsitem.headline: 72-year-old arrested in Peruvian cocaine bust.

text.p: Police on Thursday arrested a 72-year-old U.S. woman boarding a plane bound for New York and alleged that she had 17 pounds (7.8 kg) of cocaine in her bag, police said.
The arrest was the latest sign that Peruvian drug traffickers may be using the elderly as smugglers to try to outwit police and customs officers, a police source said.
Police said the woman, a Peruvian-born U.S. citizen named Odilia Mercedes Muro de Saman, had not been formally charged and that an investigations was continuing.

"Investigations are under way, and it will be up to the judge later to decide what charges to file," said a spokesman for the police anti-drug force Dinandro. He did not know her hometown in the United States.
"This is the oldest person who has been detained here in recent years. Apparently this is a new strategy," the police source said.
Muro de Saman seemed nervous as she went through customs, the source said. She was about to board a Lan Chile flight to New York when she was arrested.
